# Downstage

> Downstage (DS) is a free multitrack recorder and analog-style mixing console for macOS, made by Andrea Pollastri. One window holds a Pro Tools-style editor, a large-format console, a 64-slot rack of classic outboard, amps and meters, eight effect buses and a native CoreAudio engine. It runs on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 13 Ventura or later.

Downstage is free for personal and professional use, including commercial music, but it is not open source: it is licensed, not sold, under its own License Agreement. It works offline, with no account, no telemetry and no plugins; the only connection it makes on its own is a check for updates on downstage.it, which can be turned off.

What it does:

- Recording: up to 48 mono or linked-stereo channels, non-destructive takes drawn while recording and named after the channel and the take, punch in on the fly or on a range, pre-roll, loop recording and comping ("Use this" on the best part of any take), a tempo and meter map or a clock only for live multitracks, a click with its own strip.
- Editing: slip and grid, split, trim, fades and crossfades, clip gain from −40 to +20 dB, normalize, loop, duplicate, volume and pan automation, markers and an export range as in Pro Tools; tempo and grid detection from the audio (steady, or bar by bar to follow a band without a click) and quantize of hits or clip starts with strength and swing.
- Console: an SSL-style strip on every channel (high-pass, four parametric bands over a live analyser, four inserts, eight FX and eight aux sends, pan, VCA), four stereo groups, eight FX returns, eight VCAs, eight stereo aux outputs with a seven-band EQ, and the master with eight inserts; smart solo, solo safe and AFL; dBFS meters with peak hold on every strip and the master meter in the top bar; with more displays, Edit, Mix, FX or Rack full screen on each of them.
- Rack (65 units, up to ten factory presets each plus your own): API 2500, API 525, 1176, LA-2A, Golden Age Comp-54, Distressor, dbx 160, dbx 166, Alesis 3630, Behringer Composer, Midas PRO dynamics, Drawmer DS201 gate, de-esser, transient designer; mastering — Abbey Road TG Mastering Chain, SSL bus, Manley Vari-Mu, Fairchild 670, Shadow Hills, Manley Massive Passive, Maag EQ4, mid/side, Behringer Edison EX1, a four-band multiband, a look-ahead brickwall limiter; SSL 4000 E, Neve 88RS, API, EMI TG12345, Siemens Sitral, Midas XL4, Soundcraft and Mackie channel strips; Pultec EQP-1A, Neve 1073, Siemens W295, API 560, a guitar and bass EQ tuned by note, a 31-band matched graphic EQ, a tape machine, a lo-fi sampler; Kemper, Marshall, Vox, Fender, Roland, Orange, Brunetti guitar amps and Ampeg, Ashdown, Markbass bass amps; a six-slot pedalboard (the Boss line and bass pedals, Big Muff, Small Stone, Deluxe Memory Man, Dyna Comp, Tube Screamer, Talkbox Synth, Eventide Space, Eterna, RE-201, RE-555), a multi-effect board, wah, flanger, phaser, Dimension D, Leslie; a tuner, a spectrum analyser, a phase scope, a stereo image meter and a signal generator.
- Effects: Lexicon 480L with its LARC, hall, plate, Abbey Road Chambers, tempo-synced delay, chorus, flanger, Space Echo (twelve modes), shimmer, Quadraverb, Lexicon-style presets and SPX-style programs, true stereo in.
- Export: the stereo mix, one stem per channel or every output, of the song, the export range or the loop, as WAV (44.1–96 kHz, 16/24/32-bit) or MP3 (128–320 kbps).
- A built-in guide in English, Italian, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese, and a demo session: an instrumental song created by Andrea Pollastri with Claude, mixed in 22 channels.

Product names of the hardware that inspired the units belong to their owners and are used only to describe a sound; Downstage is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

## Download

- [Download for Mac](https://downstage.it/download): the latest disk image (drag Downstage to Applications)
- [Update manifest](https://downstage.it/updates/latest.json): the latest version, its notes, checksums and signature, as read by the app

## Docs

- [Guide](https://downstage.it/docs/): the built-in guide and the full shortcut list, in English. Same text as in the app (F1 and the ? button)
- [Guida](https://downstage.it/docs/it/), [Guide](https://downstage.it/docs/fr/), [Anleitung](https://downstage.it/docs/de/), [Guía](https://downstage.it/docs/es/), [Guia](https://downstage.it/docs/pt/)
- [Home page](https://downstage.it/): features, screenshots, the download box with version, size and SHA-256, and the FAQ
- [License Agreement and Terms of Use](https://downstage.it/terms.html)
- [Privacy Notice](https://downstage.it/privacy.html)
